html:
The Ngarinyman are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Victoria River country in the northwest of the Northern Territory. The map shows them as Ngarinman from 1600 to 1815. They speak the Ngarinyman language.

Their neighbours included the Bilinarra and Gurindji to the south and east, the Ngaliwurru and Jaminjung to the north, and the Miriwoong to the west. In the 1880s huge cattle stations, among them Victoria River Downs, took over this country, and many Ngarinyman spent the following decades working on them for rations.
